misconceptionText: The student identifies the bottom number of a fraction as the numerator, selecting the denominator when asked for the numerator and shading that many parts.
teachingImplication: Clarify the distinct vocabulary and spatial positions of fraction terms using visual labels before asking the learner to identify parts or shade models.
checkNext: Present a fraction identification task asking the student to name the numerator and denominator of a unit fraction, followed by shading a partially filled model.
